leads.jd:
Job Description: Manager-CEO's office 
 Role Overview: We are seeking a highly motivated and strategic thinker to join our team as a Strategy Associate/Manager. This role is pivotal in driving key initiatives and strategy projects that will shape the future of our organization. You will work closely with the CEO and leadership team to ensure rigor in problem-solving, strategic planning, and execution across various functions. This is meant to be a pre-MBA role, if you thrive in a fast-paced environment and are passionate about driving impactful change, this role is for you. Past Alumni have gotten admits at HBS, Wharton etc, Moved on to leadership roles at large MNCs.
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Drive Strategic Projects: Lead critical strategy projects from 0->1 and 1->10, initiating and scaling new business initiatives across the organization.
 Org-level streamlining: Ensure timely interventions and rigorous problem-solving on key projects through close collaboration with leadership.
 Business Understanding & Metrics: Develop a deep understanding of the business and success metrics, tracking progress through detailed dashboards and analytics.
 Planning & Execution: Drive quarterly and annual planning cycles across the organization, and monitor execution through regular weekly reviews.
 Culture & Change Initiatives: Collaborate with functional and organizational leadership to drive initiatives that define and evolve the company culture.
 Qualification 
 Educational Background: Strong academic pedigree with an undergraduate degree from IITs/BITS 
 Experience: 
 2-4 years of experience in strategy consulting firms (MBB, ATK, Strategy&, Dalberg, Auctus), high-growth startups (Flipkart, Ola, Swiggy), or leading corporations (ITC, HUL, P&G).
 Demonstrable spike in academic or professional achievements.
 Skills & Attributes: 
 High degree of ownership and accountability.
 Strong aptitude and ability to quickly grasp new concepts and domains.
 Proven experience in structured problem-solving and stakeholder management.
 Ability to switch contexts and manage multiple priorities with passion, hunger, and perseverance.
 Desired Personal Traits: 
 Passionate about driving change and making an impact.
 Hunger for learning and growth, with the ability to persevere through challenges.
 Strong context-switching skills, comfortable navigating complex and dynamic environments.
 Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to manage and influence senior stakeholders.
 What We Offer: 
 Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership and have a meaningful impact on the organization’s strategic direction.
 A dynamic and entrepreneurial work environment where your ideas and contributions will be highly valued.
 Competitive compensation and benefits package.
 If you are a strategic thinker with a passion for solving complex problems and driving impactful change, we would love to hear from you!

 Prodigal is the connected AI platform leading financial institutions use to run their operations.
 We work with banks, lenders, credit unions, and other financial companies that lend money to people and manage those relationships over time.
 These institutions make millions of high-stakes decisions every day. Who should they reach? When should they reach them? What should they say or offer? When should a case move to a human? How should that change based on the borrower, the account, previous interactions, and the regulations involved?
 Getting those decisions right requires a deep understanding of the people, processes, rules, and edge cases behind them.
 Prodigal has spent the last eight years building that understanding. More than a billion interactions between financial institutions and their customers have shaped the intelligence, guardrails, and AI agents we now run in production across North America.
 Today, our AI agents analyze conversations, capture context, guide human agents, decide the next action, conduct customer conversations, orchestrate outreach, and help people complete payments and resolutions. They are connected, so what is learned in one interaction can inform what happens next.
 We are expanding this swarm of AI agents across more of the work financial institutions do: originations, document processing, back-office workflows, servicing, and other critical operations where money, identity, people, and regulation intersect.
 We are backed by Y Combinator, Accel, and Menlo Ventures, and work with 100+ financial institutions across North America. Listen directly from our CTO, Cofounder - Sangram Raje

 You’ll join Prodigal’s Strategy & Operations team, the consulting arm of the company. We partner with creditors in consumer finance (Banks, NBFCs & BNPLs and debt collection agencies) to transform how they engage with consumers using data-driven insights and AI-powered workflows. The team sits at the intersection of product, data science, and client operations: designing strategy, building execution pipelines, and running experiments that deliver measurable lifts in recoveries and channel performance.

 As a Strategy & Operations Analyst, you will work with the team to execute and scale high-impact strategies and initiatives for clients. You’ll both build and scale: owning live AI based strategies, testing new ideas, identifying and solving client challenges, and driving strategic initiatives.
 This is beyond a traditional consulting role where impact ends at strategic recommendations. Here, you will own strategies end-to-end, from design to live execution. You’ll have visibility over their direct, measurable impact on real business outcomes. You’ll operate in a high-growth environment with accelerated learning, full ownership, and continuous exposure to CXOs. The role also offers periodic travel to the US for client meetings and industry conferences, giving you on-ground global exposure.

 You enjoy solving real-world problems and taking full ownership of outcomes, not just analyses.  Strategy: 
 Act as a strategic advisor and industry expert to the CXOs of the customers you manage. They will rely on you for advice on what’s best for their business
 Own end-to-end engagement strategy, defining strategies to drive improvements in collections & recoveries, self-serve usage, and consumer experience
 Design structured experimentation frameworks by crafting hypotheses, choosing success metrics, and analyzing results to continuously refine strategy and inform scalable best practices
 Partner with data science teams to shape and operationalize models (e.g., channel affinity, right-time-to-contact, offer logic), ensuring strategies correctly leverage behavioral patterns
 Analytics and Operations: 
 Develop insightful, scalable reports and dashboards to track key performance metrics and proactively track deviations, trends, and anomalies
 Lead the execution and monitoring of A/B tests to measure product improvements and optimize service delivery
 Continuously improve underlying processes and systems by designing structured experiments, analyzing results, and translating learnings into scalable improvements

 Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Mathematics or a related field (Tier 1 college from 2025 batch preferred)
 Deep interest in consulting or product management
 Relevant data analytics experience
 Proficiency in Excel, Python, SQL, and Tableau/other BI tools is preferred
 Excellent communication skills (written and verbal), with the ability to clearly present findings to stakeholders and team members
 Evaluation Process : 
 Round 1 
 Intro and communication (15 minutes)
 Problem/puzzle solving (30 minutes)
 Case study (60 minutes)
 Round 2 
 Culture fit (20 minutes)
 Final Shortlist/Offer announcement

 World-class team - You'll get the chance to learn from (and teach) some of the brightest and most skilled people you'll ever meet. Our team members have been part of BCG, Deloitte, EY, Blackstone, Meta, Amazon and are IIT, IIM, BITS alumnus.
 Continuous education - As relentless seekers of knowledge, we sponsor and support any training materials, books, courses, and exam fees for upskilling yourself in areas related to your role - but that's not where it ends. If you make a good case for some extra learning, we're delighted to foot the tab.
 Food at the office – Meals are on us. We won't let your stomach grumble while you hustle.
 Health insurance - Health always comes first. The health of your family is as important to us, as it is to you. We offer insurance coverage for both you and your family.
 Flexible schedule - We're not a "clock in, clock out" company. Morning person? Start work while the world's still sleeping. Night owl? Ramp things up while others are winding down. You're fully trusted to create the right conditions for your own personal peak productivity. We only ask that you be available to your teammates for seamless collaboration.
 Generous leave policy - Take all the time you need to recharge your batteries - no cap on vacation allowance here. Because a rested, relaxed, and refreshed mind is a happy and effective mind.
 Recreation & team activities – We regularly indulge in friendly football, table tennis, cooking sessions and challenge each other to do those extra push ups or chug that 4 th drink (of course that’s Nimbu Pani)

 About the Role 
 Meesho's CEO's Office sits at the centre of how the company makes decisions. As Senior Manager, you'll work directly with the CEO and CXOs/GMs on company strategy, the operating rhythm, and the cross-functional bets that matter most.
 This is a leadership role, not a support role. You'll own outcomes, not just inputs. Scope will shift as company priorities shift, and you'll often work without formal authority. It suits someone who is part thinker, part builder, part operator.
 You'll get a front-row seat to building and scaling a public tech company, direct impact on the company's trajectory, and a launchpad for future leadership roles at Meesho.
 About the Team 
 The CEO's Office works as a force multiplier for the CEO. We run the company's operating system: the reviews, planning cycles and performance tracking that keep leaders aligned and accountable.
 We also pick up the problems that don't sit neatly inside one function. These cut across business, product, tech and operations, and we drive them to closure with the owners.
 It's a high-trust team. We see the company's most important decisions early, and we're expected to handle that with discretion and sound judgement.
 What you will do
 Partner with the CEO 
 Be a thought partner to the CEO: help pick, structure and drive the highest-impact priorities
 Speed up CEO decisions with sharp briefs, decision frameworks and analysis
 Represent the CEO in leadership forums when needed
 Run the company operating system 
 Design and evolve the operating cadence: reviews, planning cycles, performance tracking
 Improve clarity, alignment and accountability across leadership teams
 Make sure CEO and leadership decisions get followed through, with clear owners and dates
 Lead strategic, cross-functional projects 
 Lead high-impact projects across business, product, tech and operations
 Incubate and evaluate new business opportunities and adjacencies
 Take ambiguous problems, break them down, and turn them into plans that ship
 Work with CXOs and GMs to unblock and speed up key priorities
 Shape culture and leadership 
 Reinforce leadership principles and drive leadership communication
 Influence how decisions get made and how leaders work together
 Raise the bar on thinking quality and execution discipline
 What you will need
 Detail orientation. You think in specifics. You can walk through a P&L line by line, know the unit economics of the businesses you've worked on, and cite the numbers without being asked.

 Managerial style. You get results through others. You build systems rather than stepping in as the hero, and you've led across functions without formal authority.

leads.jd:
ABOUT ATLYS
Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
Atlys http://atlys.com/ is changing that.
We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for 1M+ travellers across 127 countries. But we’re still early.
THE ROLE
As an Associate Program Manager, you will play a key role in managing and improving core processes within the Fulfilment team. Working closely with Customer Experience, Product, Engineering, and Partner teams, you will help solve operational challenges, streamline workflows, and drive process improvements to ensure seamless execution of our visa operations.
This role sits at the intersection of operations and technology, requiring strong problem-solving skills, data-driven thinking, and the ability to take ownership of projects from identifying challenges to implementing solutions. This is a 6-day, in-office role that requires a strong on-ground presence and a hands-on approach to operational execution.
THE JOB
 - Manage and streamline operational workflows: Support in managing key processes and SOPs across visa processing operations to drive efficiency and consistency.
 - Track operational performance: Monitor key metrics such as turnaround time (TAT), accuracy, and throughput, highlighting gaps and improvement opportunities.
 - Drive process improvements: Identify process bottlenecks, analyse root causes, and work on implementing solutions to improve operational efficiency.
 - Collaborate cross-functionally: Work with Product and Engineering teams to improve internal tools, streamline workflows, and identify automation opportunities.
 - Build operational dashboards: Maintain dashboards, reports, and trackers to monitor performance and support data-driven decision-making.
 - Manage day-to-day challenges: Support the resolution of operational escalations, track action items, and ensure timely closure of issues.
 - Support team development: Assist with onboarding, training, and process documentation for new operations team members and external partners.
 - Execute strategic initiatives: Work with the team on cross-functional projects and support expansion into new geographies, product lines, and visa categories.
THE IDEAL CANDIDATE
You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:
 - Have 2-4 years of experience in program management, business operations, consulting, or a similar execution-focused role.
 - Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
 - Demonstrate a high sense of ownership and the ability to take initiatives from planning through execution.
 - Are comfortable working with multiple stakeholders and navigating cross-functional dependencies.
 - Thrive in fast-paced environments, preferably within startups, logistics, operations, or central teams.
 - Are proficient in Excel or Google Sheets; familiarity with Notion, SQL, or BI dashboards is a plus.
 - Are hands-on, detail-oriented, and comfortable working closely with on-ground teams to solve operational challenges.
 - Are proactive, organised, and capable of independently driving assigned projects 
We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.
WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT
Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
Here’s what you can expect:
 - Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
 - Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.
 - A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
 - Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
 - Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
 - Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
 - Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software.
 - An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.
   
   
Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
Come build the intelligence layer for global travel

leads.jd:
WHO ARE WE?
Composio builds the AI-native automation layer for software teams: SDKs, runtimes, and platform tooling that let developers compose, evaluate, and operate agentic workflows and AI-powered products. Our systems must be reliable at scale - agents must act correctly, integrations must be robust, and integration needs to be an autonomous, observable function that accelerates engineering rather than slowing it. You'll join a small, high-leverage team building the delivery systems and metrics that give product and support teams visibility and predictable delivery.
This role is based in Bangalore (HSR).
WHO IS OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE?
A high-agency operator who is also AI-native, and who wants to grow into product. The role starts ops-heavy: you run the operations that get apps live on Composio, keep the toolkits healthy, and automate as much of that work as you can. Over 6-8 months, once those workflows and automations are running, the role shifts towards owning ambiguous product problems across the platform - triggers, tools, skills, auth, governance, and toolkit-level issues like rate limits and MCP hosting. This is not a traditional PM role with an engineering team to direct. It's closer to founder-mode ownership of a product line, where you solve problems using agents and a small ops team.
You've shipped things on your own - a side project, a tool, a micro-business, or a system you built that is still running - and you've run real operations with quality bars, not just executed inside someone else's process. You're at the edge of AI out of genuine curiosity: you use AI tools daily and can point to specific things you built or automated with them in the last month. You pick work by impact, not by how interesting it is, and you have no ego about manual work that isn't automated yet. You can hold a technical conversation with engineers without a translator, and you're comfortable owning problems that don't have a clear owner yet.
WHAT WILL THEY OWN?
 - The toolkit number: how many apps are live on Composio, and the health of the ones already live.
 - New apps, end to end: run the operations of getting them live - research, setup, QA, launch.
 - Existing toolkits: make them better with the product team, and clear the issues that stop them from working well.
 - QA and support for every toolkit you bring live. Once it's live, its quality is your problem.
 - The ops playbook: build it, run it, scale it. SOPs, small tools, AI agents before humans - you automate yourself first, and when scaling takes people, hiring them is part of the job.
 - The metrics for this function: define them, build them, watch them.
 - Product problems, as the ops layer starts running on its own: ambiguous, non-engineering problems across triggers, tools, auth, governance and toolkit-level issues - scoped, owned and shipped by you.
   
WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?
 - Experience: 2-4 years. We care more about how fast you've grown than how senior you are.
 - Technical floor: can explain what an API and an integration are, reads API docs cold, writes enough code to build small tools and automations. Not an engineer; infra-level work is not the job.
 - AI-native automation instinct: your default answer to repeated work is "how do I never do this manually again" - backed by recent, specific evidence of things you've built or automated with AI.
 - Dirty-work appetite: you happily run the manual version today while the automation is being built. This and the automation instinct are both required; we never average them.
 - Process maturity: you've designed or owned a pipeline with throughput, SLAs, or quality bars, and you left systems running behind you - not just stories.
 - Product instinct: you can take a vague problem, figure out what's actually broken, and decide what to build or fix - without waiting for a spec or a dedicated engineering team.
 - Organized ownership: routines, follow-ups, nothing dropped. You communicate clearly, in writing and in person.
 - High agency in uncertainty: given a goal with no playbook and no owner above you, you define the problem yourself and start before permission.
 - Operating maturity: this role carries a number from week one, so it needs someone who has owned outcomes before. It is not internship-shaped.
We'll pass at any stage on candidates who only want the cool parts of the job, choose work by interestingness over impact, can't explain what an API is, or do the same manual work in month three as month one.
NICE-TO-HAVE
 - Founder or early-stage experience: you've taken something from zero, or joined early and owned a function.
 - Experience with SaaS integrations, API products, or developer-facing products.
 - Built things with agents or LLM workflows beyond personal use - tools, experiment logs, side projects other people use.
 - An engineering-adjacent path: studied engineering and moved into non-technical work, or a non-CS background with things you built on the side.
 - High-throughput ops backgrounds (delivery, marketplace, physical ops) count only alongside the AI-native bar above - on their own they are not this job.
   
OUTCOMES WE EXPECT IN THE FIRST 90 DAYS
 - More toolkits live on Composio - you own the supply number, and it moved.
 - Existing toolkits repaired or unblocked without anything breaking technically.
 - A v1 ops playbook running: SOPs, automations, and AI agents handling the repeatable parts of onboarding and QA.
 - Metrics for the function defined and visible: supply, health of supply, pipeline status.
 - What this is not: usage. Usage is a product metric; this role is measured on supply and the health of supply.

leads.jd:
About:

The CEO's Office is a small, cross-functional team that incubates new products, drives the engagements that matter most to the company, and builds the systems that set and raise the bar for how teams across Sarvam work and collaborate. Problems arrive from research, product, and business, and they vary widely in shape and scope. As an Associate, you are a force multiplier for the CEO: you take an ambiguous problem, give it structure, and carry it to a result.

The work needs both breadth and depth. Breadth gives you context across the company and a clear sense of where the most important problems lie. Depth is how you deliver: you go deep on the ones that matter most and own their outcomes, working with the right people inside and outside Sarvam.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Drive 0-to-1 product and strategic bets from idea to a clear outcome, whether that ends in a working business line or a well-understood failure. The goal is to build an engine that comes up with ideas, researches and assesses them, builds and iterates on them, and takes the ones that work to steady state, often by handing them to a dedicated team.

 - Own key customer and partner engagements that are top of mind for the executive team.

About Airbound
 Our mission is to make a world where everyone has access to delivery. Where goods move as freely as information moves today.
 This is possible. Today the cost of moving on a scooter is ₹2/km. That’s the cost of moving a 150kg mass from point A to B. We’re bringing that mass down to less than 5kgs, concurrently bringing the cost down to 10 paise/km. This is how we make deliveries a reality. This is how we create a world where we’re doing billions of deliveries per day.
The tech is not there. The current cost of drone delivery is ₹100/km. We need to completely redefine the way things are done here. We’re building the world’s most efficient aircraft from the ground-up, and scaling that up to beyond anything the aerospace sector has ever seen. This cannot be an iterative process. We have to tear down all conventions and build everything up from scratch.
To do this, we need nothing less than the best engineers. The ones who care about building something fundamentally different, who are deeply curious about understanding the fundamentals of everything they’re working on, who are dreamers that believe in the impossible.
 About Operations
 Operations run Airbound's fleet and makes sure every flight is safe, on time and cost-effective. At our stage it is a strategic pillar, not a support function: it drives growth and shapes what we build. The team owns launch-site selection and setup, flight planning, fleet utilisation and client onboarding. We monitor weather, collate flight data and mine historical patterns for predictive analytics, and we write the SOPs that keep the network safe. We also own the big-ticket problems, such as cost optimization and pricing strategy. Operations is the glue that holds Airbound together. We work with engineering to turn growth ambitions into a detailed operations roadmap that directly informs product design and engineering priorities. We decide with data, not instinct. We form hypotheses, then prove or disprove them with flight logs, delivery times and cost metrics. We are process-obsessed and biased toward fast execution, always asking how we can deliver better, faster and cheaper.
 About The Role
 The Strategy & Operations Associate works directly with the Chief of Staff and the Head of Operations on high-impact projects across the Ops team. A core part of the role is building operational and financial models that project costs under different scenarios and inform how we price our delivery services. The role is full-time and on-site (no remote work), with substantial room to grow within the company.
Key Responsibilities
 Financial modelling and pricing: Build and maintain Excel models that forecast operational costs (airframe, motor and servo life, maintenance, manpower) under different growth scenarios, and use them to guide pricing and resource allocation
 Operations roadmap: Work with R&D, Manufacturing and Software to turn growth plans into an operations roadmap, with clear problem statements, constraints and success metrics
 Data-driven improvement: Analyse delivery times and cost data to find bottlenecks, and propose fixes for routes, turnaround times and inventory

 Leadership and investor reporting: Prepare concise presentations on operational plans, cost forecasts and performance metrics

 What We Offer

leads.jd:
About GoKwik 
 GoKwik is a growth operating system for D2C and eCommerce brands, helping merchants drive higher conversions, improve customer experiences and accelerate business growth. With a strong presence across India, the UK, Europe and the US, GoKwik works with 15,000+ merchants and processes over $2 billion in annual GMV.
 Why This Role Matters 
 We are looking for a Senior Manager – Strategy & Growth to work closely with the Business Head of KwikEngage and drive the overall business agenda. This is a high-ownership role that combines business strategy, financial analysis and cross-functional execution.
 You will be responsible for understanding business performance, identifying the biggest growth opportunities, translating them into actionable priorities and ensuring execution across teams. You will act as a strategic partner to the Business Head, helping drive key business decisions while ensuring that critical initiatives move forward without constant leadership intervention.
 This role is ideal for someone who can go beyond analysing business problems and take ownership of driving solutions through execution.
 What You'll Own 
 1. Business Performance & P&L Management 
 Closely track the KwikEngage P&L, including revenue, contribution margins, channel costs and overall business performance.
 Monitor merchant acquisition, movement, retention and churn trends to identify business opportunities and potential risks.
 Analyse business metrics regularly, identify performance gaps and proactively highlight areas requiring intervention.
 Build a strong understanding of the key drivers impacting business growth and profitability.
 2. Strategy & Growth Initiatives 
 Identify and prioritise 3–5 high-impact business initiatives every quarter based on business performance and growth opportunities.
 Translate business priorities into structured action plans with clear ownership, measurable outcomes and timelines.
 Drive strategic initiatives around revenue growth, contribution margin improvement, pricing, customer retention and business expansion.
 Evaluate new business opportunities, product bets and competitive developments to support strategic decision-making.
 3. Cross-functional Execution 
 Drive execution of key initiatives across Product, Sales, Customer Success, Finance and Marketing teams.
 Work with functional stakeholders to establish accountability, track progress and resolve execution bottlenecks.
 Ensure key business priorities are delivered within agreed timelines and translate into measurable business outcomes.
 Take ownership of follow-ups and closure of critical action items without requiring constant intervention from the Business Head.
 4. Business Reviews & Operating Rhythm 
 Own the weekly business review cadence, ensuring business performance, priorities and execution progress are consistently tracked.
 Build dashboards and performance trackers to monitor key business metrics and strategic initiatives.
 Identify deviations from business plans and work with relevant stakeholders to drive corrective actions.
 Establish structured review mechanisms to improve visibility, accountability and execution across teams.
 5. Business Analysis & Decision Support 
 Conduct detailed business analysis to identify trends, opportunities, risks and areas of improvement.
 Prepare structured business recommendations, decision memos and presentations for the Business Head and leadership.
 Evaluate different business scenarios and provide data-backed recommendations on strategic decisions.
 Support leadership discussions around pricing changes, new product opportunities, competitive responses and business expansion.
 6. Special Projects & Strategic Priorities 
 Lead high-impact strategic projects that may not fall within the ownership of any single function.
 Drive initiatives related to business transformation, operational efficiency and revenue or margin improvement.
 Support the development of leadership and board-level business narratives, strategic updates and business reviews.
 Take ownership of emerging business priorities and drive them from problem identification to successful execution.
 Who You Are 
 3–5 years of overall professional experience, with at least 1–2 years in a Chief of Staff, Founder's Office or Business Head's Office role.
 Experience working closely with a senior business leader who owns a P&L or business function.
 Ability to break down complex business problems, identify opportunities and translate insights into actionable business priorities.
 Proven experience driving cross-functional initiatives and getting things done through teams that do not directly report to you.
 Strong understanding of P&L, revenue drivers, contribution margins and business performance metrics.
 Comfortable working with data and independently extracting insights using SQL, Metabase or similar BI tools.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create crisp business presentations, decision memos and leadership updates.
 Ability to take end-to-end responsibility for initiatives, manage multiple priorities and drive outcomes in a fast-paced environment.
 Why GoKwik 
 At GoKwik, you will get the opportunity to work closely with business leadership and influence the growth trajectory of a rapidly scaling business. This role offers end-to-end exposure to business strategy, financial performance, product, sales and operations, giving you the opportunity to work on decisions that directly impact business outcomes. If you enjoy solving complex problems, taking ownership and turning ideas into measurable results, this is an opportunity to build towards larger business leadership and P&L responsibilities.

About The Company
 Founders today are building global companies from day one — but the systems that manage their money were built for a different era. Aspire exists to change that!
We’re building the financial operating system for global founders, bringing banking, software, and automation into a single platform so businesses can move faster across borders and stay focused on building.
Aspire is built by people who think from first principles, care deeply about solving hard problems, and take real ownership of their work. Our team brings global experience from leading fintech and technology companies, and many of us are former founders and operators who understand what it takes to build thoughtfully, make trade-offs, and deliver at scale in a global environment.
Backed by leading global investors including Y Combinator, Peak XV, and Lightspeed, Aspire has been trusted by more than 50,000 startups and growing businesses worldwide to manage their finances since 2018. Together with partners like J.P. Morgan, Visa, and Wise, we’re building for the next generation of global companies.
 About The Role
 Aspire is the all-in-one finance platform for startups and SMEs. We are hiring a Strategy & Operations Manager to own how businesses get onboarded and verified: conversion, speed, cost and quality, across our markets. Numbers-first, hands-on, shipping every week. We bring accounts, cards, payments, expense management and accounting tools together for startups and SMEs. You will work closely with senior leaders and own a core part of the customer journey.
Onboarding is a business's first real experience of Aspire. You will shape how quickly and smoothly businesses get set up and start using the platform, working with onboarding and quality teams spread across APAC and the US, and with Product, Data and Compliance.
 What You Will Do
 Own onboarding performance: conversion and time to verification by market. Find where businesses drop off, then design, test and ship the fixes across product, process and communication.
 Plan capacity: lead capacity and workforce planning and the productivity and quality metrics behind it.
 Automate: build the business case for onboarding automation and new tools, then deliver it with Product and Engineering.
 Improve processes: design and improve operating procedures with Compliance and Operations for a smooth, compliant customer experience.
 Run on data: define the metrics, work with Data on dashboards, and turn them into a weekly read and decisions.
 Lead projects: launches and cross-functional initiatives that touch onboarding.
 How We Work
 You start from the data and come back with a recommendation.
 A working v1 this week beats a perfect plan next quarter.
 You are as comfortable with analysts on the floor as in a spec review with Product.
 You run several workstreams in parallel and write clearly, so work moves across time zones without extra meetings.
 Your first 90 days
 Learn the onboarding flow and the teams that run it, build a shared view of performance and capacity, ship your first improvements, and agree targets for the next two quarters.
 Who You Are
 Typically 4+ years in strategy and operations, BizOps, consulting, or ops-heavy roles at a fintech, financial services or high-growth tech company
 Experience with onboarding, KYC/KYB, risk or another ops-heavy process is a plus
 Strong with data: you build your own analysis (SQL or advanced spreadsheet modelling) and turn it into decisions
 You take problems from diagnosis to a shipped change, and move Product, Engineering and Ops without formal authority

 Clear written English
 This is not a compliance/AML review role or a people-management role.
 Disclaimer

leads.jd:
About BharatNXT 
 BharatNXT is a business payments platform on a mission to transform how Indian MSMEs manage their working capital. By enabling credit cards for business payments, we unlock liquidity and growth potential for entrepreneurs across the country. With a growing user base and robust product roadmap, we’re now setting our sights on building a high-conversion, high-traffic website from scratch. 
 The role 
 A generalist role working directly with the founders on whatever matters most: a launch, a partner going live, a pricing call, a broken workflow. You'll own each from first analysis to shipped outcome and be judged on what moved, not on the deck. Expect to switch problems often. 
 What you'll do 
 Own founder priorities - take the initiatives the founders are driving from rough idea to launch. Research the problem, write the brief, set milestones, get product, tech, ops and growth moving, and follow through until it ships. 
 Launch things - plan and run go-to-market for new products, features and partners, from positioning and pricing to phased rollout. Get the field and telecalling teams ready, and close each launch with a review of what worked. 
 Build partnerships - help find, evaluate and pitch new lending and payment partners. Once they're signed, keep integrations and timelines on track. 
 Turn numbers into decisions - own the dashboards and weekly reviews the business runs on: transactions, payment volume, activation, retention and unit economics. Find what's moving the numbers and turn it into a clear recommendation. 
 Know the market - track competitors, MSME behaviour, and RBI and card-network rules. Turn it into a monthly brief that changes what teams do, and flag anything that needs a decision now. 
 Run experiments - design small product and growth tests on pricing, offers and onboarding. Size each one, read the results with the growth team, and recommend what to scale or kill. 
 Strengthen operations - build and fix the processes behind the company: vendor and partner agreements, renewals, finance and compliance follow-ups, and hiring support. 
 Make us faster - find manual, repetitive work across ops, support and reporting. Replace it with better process, automation or AI tools, and measure the time and cost saved. 
 Take on special projects - anything important, urgent and without an owner yet. 
 What we're looking for 
 2 - 4 years at a startup, ideally working directly with founders and across several functions. 
 Structured thinking and clear writing - you can turn a messy problem into a plan, and a plan into a one-pager founders can decide on. 
 Comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities, and you follow through without being chased. 
 Bonus: an MBA, IIT, IIM or CA and a business background. If you grew up around a family business or have run your own, MSME working-capital problems won't be abstract to you. 
 Why take it 
 You'll see every part of the business up close, from the founders' desk, and be trusted with real problems early. Pay is competitive, and the role grows as the company does. 
 If you want a 9-to-5 with a tightly defined scope, this isn't it. If you want a steep learning curve and problems that are yours to solve, it is.

leads.jd:
Lenskart - Smart Generalist & EIR 
 Senior Manager - Business Strategy & Operations 
 About the Company 
 Lenskart is Asia's largest eyewear company, serving over 40 million people across 175+ cities in India, Singapore, Dubai, and beyond. What started as an online eyewear store in 2010 has grown into an omnichannel powerhouse with 3,000+ stores, the world's most automated eyewear manufacturing facility, and a mission to serve one billion eyes. \"Good is not good enough\" is something you'll hear often at Lenskart - we're constantly pushing ourselves to redefine how people see and experience the world.
 About the Role 
 This is an opportunity to solve some of the most important business problems at one of India's fastest-scaling consumer companies. As a Senior Manager – Business Strategy & Operations, you'll work directly on high-impact strategic initiatives that shape the future of Lenskart. You'll own critical workstreams, partner with senior leaders, and drive execution across multiple business functions. This role is designed for people who thrive in ambiguity, love solving complex problems, and want significantly more ownership than a traditional strategy role offers. Please note: After submitting your application, you will receive an AI assessment via email. Completing this assessment is mandatory for progressing to the next stage of the hiring process.
 Responsibilities 
 Own high-impact strategic initiatives from problem definition to execution, ensuring measurable business outcomes.
 Partner closely with business leaders to identify growth opportunities, solve operational challenges, and improve business performance.
 Drive cross-functional projects involving Sales, Retail, Supply Chain, Marketing, Finance, Product, and Customer Experience teams.
 Build business cases, perform deep analytical problem-solving, and convert insights into actionable recommendations.
 Leverage AI extensively for research, analysis, reporting, automation, and decision-making. Develop AI-powered workflows that improve productivity and eliminate manual processes wherever possible.
 Build dashboards, operating mechanisms, and review frameworks to track business performance and ensure execution excellence.
 Get hands-on with execution by working directly with business teams, stores, vendors, and stakeholders to understand problems firsthand and implement practical solutions.
 Present structured recommendations and updates to senior leadership through crisp communication and data-backed insights.
 Qualifications 
 Undergraduate degree from an IIT (or another top-tier engineering institute) and/or an MBA from an IIM or another leading global business school.
 2–5 years of experience in management consulting (McKinsey, BCG, Bain, Kearney, Strategy&, Oliver Wyman, etc.), investment banking, founder's office, CEO's office, business strategy, business operations, or high-growth startups.
 Strong analytical and structured problem-solving capabilities with experience handling complex, ambiguous business problems.
 Demonstrated ownership of high-impact projects with measurable business outcomes.
 Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority.
 Strong proficiency in Excel/Sheets, SQL (preferred), data analysis, and business storytelling.
 Daily user of AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Cursor, or similar) with the ability to build AI-assisted workflows, automations, or lightweight agents that improve business productivity.
 Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to simplify complex ideas into clear recommendations.
 Founder, startup, or entrepreneurial experience will be considered a strong advantage.
 What You Can Expect 
 Ownership of business-critical initiatives with visible impact on the company's growth.
 Direct exposure to senior leadership and opportunities to influence key strategic decisions.
 A fast-paced, founder-led environment where exceptional performance is recognized with accelerated growth and responsibility.
 The opportunity to work across multiple business functions and gain a holistic understanding of scaling a global consumer brand.
 A culture that values first-principles thinking, speed, ownership, and continuous learning.
 The chance to build meaningful solutions using AI and modern technology while solving real business problems.
 A role that can become a defining milestone in your career—not because of the title, but because of the scale of problems you'll solve and the impact you'll create.
 Note: An AI assessment will be shared via email after application. Completing it is mandatory for progressing to the next stage.

leads.jd:
About Origin
 Origin (previously 10xConstruction) is building general-purpose autonomous robots for US construction to tackle rising costs, safety risks, and labour shortages. Our modular, multi-trade platform combines purpose-built hardware with real-time site intelligence to navigate complex environments and execute tasks with precision. Trained in high-fidelity simulation and already deployed on live sites, our robots deliver 5x faster execution, 250%+ margin expansion, and significant cost savings. Join India's most talent-dense robotics team consisting of individuals from IITs, Stanford, UCLA, etc.
 About the role
 Origin is moving from building robots one at a time to building them in batches. The parts of that system already exist: sourcing, stores, assembly, quality, logistics and deployment. They don't yet run as one machine. This role exists to make them one.
 You will work directly with the Founder and own the build from release to US site: one build plan, one cost number per robot, and one weekly review everyone works from. You will also run the founder's manufacturing projects that don't yet have a home. This is not a coordination role. You're measured on robots shipped on time, at cost, without field failures.
 Key Responsibilities
 1. Build planning and operating cadence 
 Turn the deployment pipeline into a rolling 8-week build plan by robot, sub-assembly and tool system.
 Run the weekly build reviews with Sourcing, Manufacturing, QA and Deployment teams; own the action log and close it.
 Maintain a single build-readiness view: kits complete, parts short, drawings released, test status.
 Work with Engineering, QA & manufacturing teams to set-up DFM, IQC, IPQA processes and create right Jigs & fixtures for QA & assembly.
 2. Cost and unit economics 
 Own the cost-per-robot model from the BOM, labour hours, scrap and freight, and keep it current with every design release.
 Build the cost-down roadmap with Sourcing and Engineering; track savings against target each month.
 Model landed cost to US sites, including duties and freight, for founder and investor conversations.
 3. Quality and field feedback 
 Set up the loop from US site failures back to design, sourcing and assembly, with root cause and a closed corrective action on each.
 Track first-pass yield, rework hours and failures per deployed robot; take the top issues to the founder each week.
 4. Scale-up and founder projects 
 Lead make-vs-buy and contract-manufacturing evaluations for the next robot versions.
 Plan plant layout, line balancing and capacity for the next step up in volume.
 Prepare manufacturing updates for board and investor material.
 Required Qualifications and Skills
 B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical & Electronics, Production, Industrial, Manufacturing or Mechatronics Engineering.

leads.jd:
Job Application for Founder’s Office: Revenue Operations & Systems (RevOps) at Enterpret 
 Back to jobs 
 Founder’s Office: Revenue Operations & Systems (RevOps)
 Bengaluru, Onsite
 Apply 
 About Enterpret
 As the world moves to AI native applications, one element matters more than anything: the data.
 At Enterpret, we are unlocking the most impactful dataset for businesses, customer feedback. We centralize feedback across every source, like Twitter, Salesforce, Zendesk, Slack, Intercom, community forums, surveys, and Gong calls, into a single knowledge graph. On top of it we build an adaptive taxonomy for each customer and an agent platform that lets teams query, monitor, and act on customer intelligence wherever they work, whether that's inside Enterpret, in Slack, or in their own AI tools through our MCP server.
 Our customers include companies like Canva, Harvey, Zapier, WisprFlow, ElevenLabs, OpenRouter, Western Union, and several other Product Led Growth decacorns and F500 companies.
 About the role
 Enterpret is looking for a sharp, data-driven operator to drive high-impact strategic and operational initiatives across the company, with a primary focus on revenue operations and business systems.
 As a member of our BizOps team reporting to the Chief of Staff to the Co-Founder, whose portfolio spans Business Operations and Product Operations, you will operate at the intersection of operations, finance, and GTM as a trusted problem solver and thought partner to teams across the business.
 This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role for an experienced individual contributor who enjoys solving hard problems and building systems that work. You will understand priorities, recommend solutions and take work from an unclear starting point to a working result.
 You will own and improve the workflows that connect our Sales, Marketing and Customer Success teams. This includes how leads reach the right person, how opportunities move through the pipeline, how teams use reliable data and how approved commercial terms flow into operational systems.
 We use AI as part of how we work. We want someone who can use it to learn, analyse, build and automate, while staying accountable for accuracy and quality.
 Why this role
 You will have real ownership of revenue workflows and the autonomy to improve how they work. Working directly with the Chief of Staff and closely partnering with the Head of Revenue and CEO, you will shape the systems behind our revenue operations and see the impact of your work.
 What you will do
 Proactively identify problems in our revenue workflows, recommend what matters most and own improvements through to measurable results.
 Own and improve core revenue workflows, including lead routing, opportunity management, renewals and the handoffs between teams.
 Understand our CRM and connected systems well enough to find the cause of issues, fix them safely and prevent them from recurring.
 Keep revenue data reliable. Define metrics clearly, reconcile conflicting records and build reporting people can use to make decisions.
 Support pipeline reviews, forecasting and quarterly planning with accurate inputs, clear risks and useful recommendations.
 Work with Finance and commercial teams to keep approved deal terms, subscription records and billing handoffs aligned. Help resolve exceptions without making policy or financial commitments on your own.
 Build useful automations and AI-assisted workflows. Test them with real users, monitor their results and improve them after launch.
 Drive cross-functional work forward. Agree on owners and dates, raise blockers early and bring the right people together when a decision is needed.
 Leave behind clear documentation and maintainable systems, not solutions that depend on one person remembering how they work.
 What we are looking for
 Experience owning revenue operations, business systems or closely related operational work. You can show work you personally took from problem to result.
 Hands-on experience with a CRM such as Salesforce or HubSpot and the workflows around it. You can explain more than the dashboard layer.
 Strong analytical skills. You are comfortable working with spreadsheets and SQL, checking data quality and explaining what the numbers mean.
 The ability to build and troubleshoot integrations or automations using APIs, tools such as n8n or Zapier, or lightweight code.
 Practical use of AI tools and agents, with a clear method for checking their output and measuring whether they help.
 Curiosity, sound judgment and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems quickly.
 Clear, concise communication and the confidence to work directly with people across teams and levels.
 A habit of following through. You keep people informed and verify that a change actually worked.
 We welcome relevant experience from different backgrounds. The strongest evidence is the work you have owned and the judgment you brought to it.
 Why Enterpret
 High Impact: Own the heaviest data systems in the company — the databases, models, and pipelines behind the product — at the moment the scale story gets much more interesting: larger enterprise customers and large-scale PLG volume.
 Ownership: End-to-end responsibility for features and systems.
 Complex Challenges: Make hard-to-reverse, 1–2 year architecture decisions across distributed databases, model hosting, and high-throughput pipelines, where a single change touches storage, query paths, reliability, and cost.
 Growth: Lead future programs such as self-hosting and regional expansion to Europe and India, with an open L6 IC path for someone who can own long-term platform strategy and raise the bar across the team.
 Culture: Open, collaborative, and values-driven environment with autonomy.
 Benefits: Competitive salary, equity, hybrid work setup, premium healthcare, and more.
 What We Value
 At Enterpret, we operate with a deep sense of ownership — we play for the team and do what it takes to win together. We care personally for our teammates while pushing each other with honest, actionable feedback. Above all, we approach everything with humility and a drive to keep learning and getting better.
 Equal Opportunities
 We are an equal opportunity employer. We ensure that none of our employees or prospective employees receives less favourable treatment as a result of age, sex, disability, marital status, colour, race, religion or ethnic origin. Equally we aim to ensure that no such employee is disadvantaged by terms and conditions of employment which cannot be justified.

The pod operates like an autonomous business unit: defining local strategy, executing marketing and growth plans, running platform operations, and generating the consumer insights that drive every commercial decision.
This is not a support function. Every person in this pod owns outcomes — revenue, margin, platform health, or market intelligence. If you are commercially driven, data-fluent, and thrive in a fast-moving execution environment, this team is built for you.
 What You Will Do
 Revenue & P&L 
 Own and deliver revenue and gross margin targets for an assigned geography or function within the pod 
 Track P&L on a weekly and monthly basis — identify gaps early and course-correct with data 
 Drive revenue growth through a mix of new user acquisition, base reactivation, and improved margin per transaction 
 Identify and unlock new revenue opportunities — brand partnerships, channel monetisation, and promotional levers 
 Marketing, Growth & Campaigns 
 Plan and execute user acquisition campaigns to drive installs and first-order conversions at efficient CAC 
 Own reactivation marketing for lapsed and install-not-transacted user cohorts 
 Design and run CRM, push notification, and in-app messaging campaigns to improve repeat purchase frequency 
 Execute on-app promotions, deal constructs, offer panels, and sale events — end-to-end, accurately and on time 
 Build and manage hyperlocal BTL activation plans tied to regional events, festivals, and seasonal demand peaks 
 Promote high-margin SKUs and categories to improve the overall GM profile of the geography
 Market Intelligence & Consumer Insights 
 Build and maintain a revenue intelligence framework covering consumer spending patterns, competitive pricing, and category growth 
 Lead quantitative research: cohort analysis, pricing elasticity studies, and transactional data mining 
 Conduct qualitative research: consumer focus groups, in-depth interviews, and retailer feedback sessions 
 Produce competitive intelligence reports — share of wallet, competitor activity, and whitespace opportunities 
 Generate data-backed demand signals for new SKUs and assortment decisions 
 Platform Health & Fulfilment 
 Own platform revenue health KPIs: availability rate, catalogue fill, listing quality, order completion, and RTO 
 Identify and plug revenue leakage — stock-outs during campaign periods, broken listings, and fulfilment failures 
 Coordinate with Supply Chain and Inventory teams to ensure stock availability ahead of activations 
 Escalate platform issues — broken listings, payment failures, checkout drop-offs — with revenue-impact quantification 
 Own fulfilment SLAs; work with logistics partners to reduce TAT, RTO, and delivery failures 
 Analytics & Reporting 
 Maintain a real-time revenue dashboard and weekly health scorecard accessible to the entire pod 
 Run weekly sales trend and insights analysis to identify performance gaps and activation opportunities 
 Report on key metrics: installs, CAC, reactivation rate, traffic, GM impact, and channel revenue contribution 
 Translate complex data into clear, commercially actionable narratives for business decisions 
 Who We Are Looking For
 Must Have
 Engineering degree from a Tier 1/2 institution [IIT (Bombay/ Delhi/ Madras/ Kanpur/ Kharagpur/ Roorkee/ Guwahati/ Hyderabad/ Indore/ Gandhinagar/ Bhubaneswar/ Ropar), BITS Pilani (Pilani/ Goa/ Hyderabad), NIT (Trichy/ Warangal/ Surathkal/ Calicut/ Rourkela), DTU, VIT, NSIT, IIIT (Hyderabad/ Bangalore)] 
 2–6 years of experience in one or more of: revenue management, performance marketing, trade sales, consumer insights, e-commerce operations, or P&L-owning commercial roles 
 Strong commercial acumen — ability to connect marketing and operational actions directly to revenue and margin outcomes 
 Data fluency: comfortable with Excel, SQL, BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or equivalent), and building dashboards or revenue models
 Experience working cross-functionally across Brand, Supply Chain, Product, and Marketing teams 
 Proven track record of execution in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment 
 Good to Have
 Prior experience in a geography or zonal business role in e-commerce, Q-commerce, FMCG, or consumer tech 
 Exposure to CRM platforms, push notification tools, or on-app promotion management dashboards 
 Experience with qualitative research methodologies: FGDs, in-depth interviews, ethnographic observation 
 Knowledge of trade economics: margins, sell-through rates, distributor ROI, and channel profitability 
 Basic knowledge of Python or R for data processing and analysis 
 Proficiency in regional language(s) of the assigned state — advantage for primary research and on-ground activation 
 What We Offer
 Competitive compensation — reviewed based on role level, experience, and fitment 
 Direct ownership of business outcomes from Day 1 — revenue, margin, or market intelligence 
 Mentorship from senior P&L leaders and a clear pathway to leadership roles 
 High-velocity, commercially focused culture built on ownership, experimentation, and speed 
 Work at the intersection of marketing, technology, and commerce — in a category with significant growth headroom

leads.jd:
Emergent builds autonomous coding agents that replace traditional software development by generating, testing, and deploying production applications directly from plain-language intent. Our systems run in production at global scale and are used to build millions of real applications.
 Since our public launch, we’ve crossed $130M in Annualised Revenue and grown to over 10M users across 190+ countries , who have built 12M+ applications on Emergent. We’re backed by Creaegis, Khosla Ventures, SoftBank, Lightspeed, Together, Y Combinator, Google, Claypond and Sentinel Global. 
 We’re solving the hard part of AI-driven software creation: correctness, reliability, security, and scale in real production systems. The team is built by repeat founders, Olympiad medalists, IIT & IIM alumni, and leaders from Google, Amazon, and Dropbox. 
 We’re hiring builders who want ownership, speed, and impact at global scale.
 The Role: 
 We’re hiring a Growth Manager with a strong analytics backbone to drive engagement, retention, and monetization across the user lifecycle. The way you’ll do it is through data: querying it yourself, finding the insight, and turning it into interventions that move the numbers. You’ll own one growth metric end-to-end. The pace is fast and a lot is still being defined, often you’ll be the one defining it.
 What You’ll Do: 
 Own one KPI (e.g. retention, top-up rate, plan upgrades, or revenue per signup) with a weekly read of what moved and why
 When a number breaks, find the root cause, the questions a standard dashboard can’t answer, size it, and say what to do about it
 Analyze user behavior across cohorts, funnels, and segments to find levers across activation, credits and top-ups, pricing and plans, and churn
 Design, run, and read experiments properly: hypothesis, sample size, holdouts, and the decision rule fixed before launch
 Work with product, pricing, CRM, and marketing to ship what the data says
 Use AI tools (LLMs, agents) to speed up your own analysis and to automate and personalize lifecycle interventions
 What We’re Looking For: 
 2 to 4 years in growth, product, analytics, strategy, or a related role. Background is open; working hands-on with data is not
 Strong SQL skills, this is non-negotiable: you can independently query large datasets to build cohorts, funnels, and retention curves, and you validate your numbers before anyone else does
 Comfort living in data day-to-day: dashboards, product analytics tools, and spreadsheets are your home turf, and you form and test hypotheses from the data rather than waiting for someone to hand you an insight
 You’ve owned a metric and moved it, and you can show the before and after
 Working knowledge of experiment stats: significance, novelty effects, and when not to trust a result
 Comfortable using LLMs and AI tools in your day-to-day work
 Good to Have: 
 Consumer or self-serve SaaS experience
 Python

leads.jd:
Read this part first 
 Experience: 2 to 8 years
 Location: HSR Layout, BLR
 Most Strategy and Operations roles quietly turn into reporting jobs. You pull the numbers, format the decks, and remind people about deadlines. This is not that role. 
 This is the role for someone who wants to learn, at close range, how a fast growing company actually plans, prioritizes, and executes. You will work directly with the CEO and the leadership team on the problems that cut across functions, the ones no single team can solve alone. Your job is to turn ambiguity into a plan, and a plan into results.
 For the right person, this also happens to be one of the best leadership educations available anywhere. People who do this job well at Hevo build the instincts of a real operator, and many go on to run things. But the simplest reason to take it is this: you get to work on what matters most, alongside the people who decide it.
 What you will own: 
 1. The operational rhythm of the whole company. You will work with the CEO to keep the entire machine moving across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Engineering, HR, Solutions, and Support. You will run the OKR process with the leadership team, drive quarterly planning and goal setting, and track delivery so nothing important slips. You will be the person who can tell, on any given day, how healthy the organization really is and where attention is needed next.
 2. The strategic projects that move the needle. You will partner with the CEO and other leaders to spot the initiatives that genuinely change the trajectory of the business, then own them end to end until they are big enough to stand on their own and get handed to a dedicated team. These are the bets that matter most, and you will be trusted to carry them.
 3. Cross functional execution and alignment. You will be the connective tissue across functions, driving communication so the company moves as one. You will be a real thought partner to leadership on vision, priorities, and the hard tradeoffs. You will manage relationships with stakeholders inside and outside the company, and when needed, represent leadership in reviews.
 Why this role is special: 
 Three things make this seat genuinely rare.
 You get the full view. Most people spend a decade seeing one function. You will see all of them at once, from the vantage point of the executive team, inside a company growing fast enough to teach you something new every week.
 You work on first of a kind problems. Nearly every problem you solve will be one you have not solved before. There is no playbook handed to you. You build the playbook. For the right person, that is the most fun part of the job.
 You build an operator's judgment. Custodian of rhythm, owner of strategic projects, thought partner to leadership. That is the exact muscle set strong operators and founders are made of. You will leave this role with judgment most people take many more years to develop.
 What you will need to bring: 
 We hire for abilities first…

leads.jd:
About FirstClub
 At FirstClub, we are building a new kind of quick commerce from the ground up, and the supply chain is where that promise is won or lost.
The Supply Chain Product team builds the systems that decide what we buy, where it sits, how it moves and what we promise each member.
Every order that reaches a member on time, fresh and complete is the output of our products.
 The Team's Charter Spans The Full Supply Chain
 Buying & Sourcing : demand-led purchase planning, vendor management, PO lifecycle and inbound scheduling.
 Collection Centers : first-mile intake, quality checks, grading and consolidation of fresh and farm produce.
 Distribution Centers (DCs) : inbound, putaway, storage, picking, packing, outbound and returns.
 Middle Mile : DC-to-Club House replenishment, trip planning, vehicle utilization and inventory movement.
 Club Houses : receiving, storage, pick-pack, cycle counts, freshness and wastage control.
 Inventory Management : single source of truth for stock, ageing and expiry, replenishment and inventory accuracy across nodes.
 Capacity Management : labor, slot, storage and throughput planning across nodes and time of day.
 Promise Engine : what we promise each member - availability and delivery ETA - based on live inventory and capacity.
 Why FirstClub
 Build, don't babysit : Much of our supply chain stack is being built right now. You will design core systems, not just tune someone else's.
 Small team, big surface area : You'll own outcomes that would sit with a whole team at a larger company.
 Fast loops : Ship on Monday, watch it run on a Club House floor by Wednesday, improve it by Friday.
 Ground truth over slide decks : Our PMs spend real time in DCs, Collection Centers and Club Houses, not just in dashboards.
 Scrappy beats perfect : We'd rather run a pilot this week than polish a plan for next quarter.
 Your fingerprints on the company : The decisions you make now shape how FirstClub scales to every new city.
 The Role
 As a Product Manager on Supply Chain, you will own one or more problem areas across our supply chain end to end, with scope shaped by your strengths and the team's priorities.
You will spend real time on the ground with our operations teams, turn what you see into clear problem statements, and ship tools that make operations faster, more accurate and cheaper.
 What You Will Do
 Own the roadmap, PRDs and delivery for your area, from discovery through launch, adoption and iteration.
 Build process tools for frontline and planning teams that are simple to use, work in real operating conditions and hold up at peak hours.
 Work with Operations to map current workflows, find where time, stock or money is lost, and fix it with product.
 Own and move the core metrics for your area, such as accuracy, productivity, availability, cost and wastage.
 Work across team boundaries so your area connects cleanly with the rest of the supply chain stack.
 Write clear specs and work daily with Engineering, Design, Data and QA to ship on time with quality.
 Define success metrics up front, set up dashboards, run pilots in one or two nodes, and scale what works.
 Drive adoption on the ground : SOP changes, training material and feedback loops with site managers and associates.
 Use AI and automation where they remove manual effort - for example, exception detection, smart nudges to frontline teams, or automated decisions.
 What We Are Looking For
 2 - 5 years of experience in Product Management, or in a product-adjacent role (operations excellence, program management, business analytics, engineering) with at least 1 - 2 years owning product outcomes.
 Experience in quick commerce, e-commerce, food delivery, logistics, warehousing, retail or another operations-heavy business.
 A solid understanding of supply chain or operations workflows, and the curiosity to go deep on new ones quickly.
 Strong first-principles problem solving; you can break a messy operational problem into measurable parts.
 Comfort with data : you write SQL, build your own dashboards and make decisions from numbers.
 Clear written and verbal communication; you can explain a spec to an engineer and a workflow change to a frontline associate.
 Bias for action, high ownership and willingness to spend time on the floor.
 Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business or a related field. An MBA is a plus but not required.
 Good To Have
 Built or shipped tools used by frontline or operations teams.
 Exposure to WMS, OMS, ERP or procurement systems.
 Experience with fresh, perishable or cold-chain categories, including FEFO and expiry management.
 Exposure to planning, forecasting or optimisation problems.
 Hands-on use of AI tools in product work, or experience shipping ML-driven features.
 (ref:hirist.tech)

leads.jd:
Program Manager – Retail 
 What you'll do 
 Retail excellence & governance 
 - Define, document and roll out SOPs for every customer-facing process, from walk-in to order to follow-up. 
 - Run the operating cadence: daily performance tracking, weekly reviews with centre leadership and monthly business reviews. 
 - Run compliance audits and service-standard checks across centres, and drive the fixes to closure. 
 - Track issues and actions from every review, with owners and deadlines, until they are resolved. 
 Performance management 
 - Build and own the retail KPI framework (revenue, footfall, conversion, order value, productivity) and the dashboards leadership uses to run the business. 
 - Produce the weekly and monthly business review packs: what moved, why it moved and what to do next. 
 - Track profitability for each centre (gross margin, operating costs, contribution) and build turnaround plans for centres that are underperforming. 
 Planning & incentives 
 - Run annual, quarterly and monthly target setting with leadership, broken down to each centre and each salesperson. 
 - Design sales incentive schemes that reward the right behaviours, model what they will cost, and own the monthly payout process with Finance and HR. 
 Customer experience 
 - Own customer experience metrics (NPS, feedback, complaints). Find the root causes and fix them at the process level. 
 - Drive CRM adoption and data discipline so every lead gets a timely, high-quality follow-up. 
 Strategic initiatives 
 - Find, pilot and scale initiatives that improve conversion, productivity or customer experience. 
 - Lead retail-tech projects (CRM enhancements, call tracking, AI-led conversation insights, in-store analytics) through business case, vendor selection, pilot, rollout and adoption. 
 - Work with category, marketing and supply chain teams on high-margin category growth, footfall programs and clearing blockers on the floor. 
 Who you are 
 - 2–4 years in program management, retail operations or business ops, ideally in multi-location retail, omnichannel or consumer businesses. 
 - You use AI tools to automate reporting, analyse data and build trackers and workflows. You get leverage from AI, not just help writing emails. 
 - Comfortable with data: spreadsheets and dashboards are second nature. SQL is a plus. 
 - You handle stakeholders across centre teams, leadership and central functions, and you are as comfortable on the shop floor as in a review meeting. 
 - Structured problem-solver with a strong bias to action and follow-through. 
 Location: Bengaluru. Travel to Experience Centres expected.

leads.jd:
Business Analyst – MD's Office 
 About the Company 
 BPL Medical Technologies is a leading Indian medical technology company committed to advancing healthcare through innovative, reliable, and accessible solutions. With a strong legacy and nationwide presence, BPL serves hospitals, clinics, and healthcare providers across India and select international markets.
 The company offers a diverse portfolio across patient monitoring, imaging, and critical care, supported by robust manufacturing, service, and distribution capabilities. With a growing installed base and a focus on quality and customer trust, BPL continues to strengthen its position as a trusted partner in healthcare delivery.
 Driven by innovation and operational excellence, BPL is focused on building future-ready capabilities and delivering long-term value to customers, partners, and stakeholders.
 Get to know about us - https://www.bplmedicaltechnologies.com/ 
 Role Summary 
 This is a high-impact role that combines business analysis, strategic planning, performance monitoring and executive support. The individual will work closely with the MD and senior leadership team to analyse business performance, identify opportunities for improvement, track strategic priorities and drive execution across functions.
 The role requires someone who can go beyond preparing reports and dashboards – someone who can interpret data, generate meaningful insights, connect the dots across the business and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
 The individual will also support the MD in managing key priorities, coordinating cross-functional initiatives, preparing leadership presentations and driving special projects.
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Business Analysis & Performance Management 
 Analyse business performance across key functions, including Sales, Service, Manufacturing, Finance, Supply Chain and other business units.
 Develop and maintain business dashboards, MIS reports and performance trackers to monitor key business metrics and KPIs.
 Identify trends, performance gaps, risks and opportunities through data analysis and provide actionable insights to management.
 Conduct variance analysis against budgets, forecasts and business plans.
 Support financial and operational analysis, including revenue, profitability, cost structures and productivity.
 Develop business models, forecasts and scenario analyses to support management decisions.
 2. MD Office & Strategic Initiatives 
 Work closely with the MD in translating strategic priorities into actionable plans, milestones and measurable outcomes.
 Track key business initiatives and ensure timely follow-through on decisions taken during leadership meetings.
 Coordinate with functional heads to monitor progress, identify bottlenecks and drive accountability.
 Prepare periodic business reviews, management updates and strategic presentations for the MD and leadership team.
 Support the MD in evaluating new business opportunities, partnerships, market expansion and other strategic initiatives.
 Undertake special projects and assignments as directed by the MD.
 3. Business Planning & Research 
 Support the annual business planning, budgeting and forecasting processes.
 Conduct market, competitor and industry research to identify emerging trends and business opportunities.
 Prepare business cases and feasibility assessments for new initiatives and investments.
 Evaluate business performance against industry benchmarks and internal targets.
 Provide data-backed recommendations to improve operational efficiency and business performance.
 4. Leadership Reporting & Executive Communication 
 Prepare high-quality presentations, dashboards, reports and briefing notes for the MD and senior leadership team.
 Consolidate business updates from various functions into meaningful management reports.
 Support preparation of materials for Board meetings, quarterly business reviews and other leadership forums.
 Develop clear and concise communication of complex business information for senior stakeholders.
 5. Cross-Functional Coordination 
 Work closely with functional leaders across the organisation to gather information, assess business priorities and drive execution.
 Facilitate coordination between teams to ensure alignment on key organisational initiatives.
 Follow up on action items, deliverables and timelines arising from leadership discussions.
 Maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgement while handling sensitive business information.
 What We’re Looking For 
 Qualifications & Experience 
 MBA from a reputed institute, preferably in Finance, Strategy or Business Management; alternatively, an Engineering or Commerce graduate with strong analytical and business acumen.
 2–4 years of experience in Business Analysis, Management Consulting, Strategy, Business Operations or a MD/Leadership Office.
 Experience in preparing business dashboards, management reports, financial analysis and leadership presentations.
 Exposure to manufacturing, healthcare or MedTech would be an added advantage.
 Technical Skills 
 Advanced proficiency in MS Excel, including data analysis, financial modelling and reporting.
 Strong PowerPoint skills with the ability to develop crisp, impactful leadership presentations.
 Familiarity with Power BI or other business intelligence and data visualisation tools.
 Understanding of financial statements, business metrics, budgeting and forecasting.
 Ability to work with large datasets and convert information into meaningful business insights.
 Core Competencies 
 Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
 Excellent business acumen and commercial awareness.
 Structured thinking with the ability to connect data, business performance and strategic priorities.
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
 Strong stakeholder management and ability to work with senior leadership.
 High ownership, accountability and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
 Ability to manage multiple priorities and work in a fast-paced environment.
 High integrity, maturity and discretion in handling confidential information.
 Why This Role Matters 
 Work directly with the MD and gain exposure to organisation-wide business strategy and decision-making.
 Get an opportunity to understand the business end-to-end, across sales, manufacturing, finance, service and operations.
 Take ownership of high-impact business projects and strategic initiatives.
 Build strong business, analytical and leadership capabilities.
 Be part of a growing MedTech organisation where your work contributes directly to business outcomes and organisational growth.
 Location - Bangalore
